scope: Experimental format-five append/retract transport. Default PublicDuckDBBackend and makeDuckDBRuntime remain selected by existing callers.
contract: Existing buildRow owns public shape and values. C++ emits physical carrier validation, conversion and retained charging.
Seven Triplex carriers retain caller IDs, commit positions and timestamps. Binary64 values use existing exact bit helpers, and public zero normalization is preserved.
Chunks use the existing caller transaction and poisoned-owner queue. Missing retraction returns false. Failed later chunks roll back previous chunks, receipt and clock changes.
All compatibility dispatch uses the raw port path and invalidates owned integrity before execution.
This transport does not add schema-aware fact transaction semantics. Raw valid JSON payload text can be noncanonical, matching the retained-carrier contract.
covered: All seven public value carriers compared against existing typed Appender by all physical assertion columns, payload hashes, carrier bits, public results, history and logical usage.
Positive and negative binary64 subnormal, signed-zero normalization, maximum finite doubles and date values, fractional metadata and intervals with equal integral ceilings, saturated integral ticks.
Caller-selected IDs/positions/times, command claim identity, same-position retraction, soft missing retraction and read-your-writes.
Late duplicate and oversized-row failure roll back all chunks even when caller catches, followed by healthy reuse.
Malformed public rows, 129-row count, storage capacity, missing usage singleton, exact32KiB JSON envelope and one-byte-over rejection.
Owned activation followed by raw mutation invalidation and successful real re-audit.
Existing11 adapter methods include persistent restart, original Effect fiber rollback, interruption, driver lifecycle, Appender parity and abrupt-exit recovery.

first_failures.fix: Give the source fixture array its TripleInput contextual type.

first_failures.observed: Initial physical diagnostic passed NULL v_f to the exact bit scalar.
first_failures.fix: Apply the scalar only to present floating carriers.

first_failures.fix: Use explicit envelope byte/nonempty/NUL admission; SQL JSON validation and existing public normalization own remaining shape/text checks.

first_failures.observed: Tests matched the outer generic rollback message instead of its preserved cause.
first_failures.fix: Assert ROLLED_BACK and the expected cause message.

performance: Unmeasured. No throughput, latency improvement or default-cutover claim. Final acknowledgement currently joins inserted IDs through the public view and needs retained-history profiling.
